units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 144:13">Targ. Ps. CXLIV, 13</cite> (h. text <cite ref="G00558"><he>זן</he></cite>); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 34a:8">Ab. Zar. 34ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>תריסר ירחי ש׳</he> twelve months of the year, a regular year.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 18b:12">Snh. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ועברוה … לההיא ש׳</he> and the Rabbis declared that year a leap-year.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:16">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>בלילי ריש ש׳</he> in the night of the New Year.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:16">Ib.</cite> <he>בסיפא דש׳</he> at the end of the year; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U00202"><he>שְׁנָתָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U01562"><he>שְׁנָא</he> II</cite>.
